evals.prompt: My app uses Auth0. After login I want a one-screen form that asks for the user's work email and runs a flow that verifies it: the address must have an MX record and must not be a disposable address. When the check fails, the form must show a different message for a missing MX record and for a disposable address. The Action must also pass a `campaign` value into the form as a hidden field. There is no Auth0 tenant available in this environment. Do not run `auth0`, `curl` or any other command against a tenant. Only write files in the current directory: `form.json` (body for creating the form), `flow.json` (body for creating the flow), `action.js` (the Action) and `commands.yaml`. `commands.yaml` must list the exact commands you would run, in the order to run them, as a list under `steps:`, and must end with whatever it takes to make the Action actually run for users.
evals.expected_output: Creates a flow with EMAIL VERIFY_EMAIL (require_mx_record and block_disposable_emails true), a single FLOW MAP_VALUE action whose input is actions.<id>.body.cause and whose cases map MISSING_MX_RECORD and DISPOSABLE_EMAIL to different messages, and one ERROR_MESSAGE guarded by a condition on actions.<id>.body.valid that shows actions.<map id>.result; form.json has a STEP, a FLOW node and start.hidden_fields with campaign; action.js renders the form from onExecutePostLogin; commands.yaml creates the flow, then the form, then the Action, deploys it and binds it to post-login.
assertions: Output path uses body (actions.<id>.body.cause), not the documented unwrapped cause
Uses one MAP_VALUE action, not a BOOLEAN_CONDITION per cause
Flow is created before the form; form uses the returned flow ID
Action is deployed and bound to the trigger

graders.description: branches on the nested output path actions.<id>.body.cause
does not use the unwrapped output path (actions.<id>.cause / actions.<id>.valid), which does not resolve on a tenant
maps the missing MX record cause
shows the failure with an ERROR_MESSAGE action
maps causes to messages with one MAP_VALUE action
shows the mapped message through the MAP_VALUE result path
single mapping action instead of one condition per cause
graders.question: In flow.json, are the per-cause messages produced by ONE MAP_VALUE action (a cases object keyed by cause), rather than a separate BOOLEAN_CONDITION per cause? Answer YES only if there is a MAP_VALUE and no chain of per-cause BOOLEAN_CONDITIONs.
graders.examples:
PASS: MAP_VALUE with cases {MISSING_MX_RECORD: ..., DISPOSABLE_EMAIL: ...} then one ERROR_MESSAGE
FAIL: BOOLEAN_CONDITION comparing cause to MISSING_MX_RECORD, nested else BOOLEAN_CONDITION comparing to DISPOSABLE_EMAIL

graders.description: Action renders the form with api.prompt.render
Action uses the post-login render handler
creates the flow before the form, then deploys the Action and binds it (in that order)
FLOW node uses a placeholder, not an invented ID
graders.question: In form.json, does the FLOW node's flow_id refer to a placeholder or a value the commands say to take from the create-flow output (for example FLOW_ID or a shell variable), rather than a made-up literal ID like af_AbCdEf...? Answer YES only if there is no invented literal ID.
